# Papercuts — openarc

Small frictions hit while working, logged in the moment (D-027). None of these blocked anything; together they show where the project needs sanding down. Newest first.

- 2026-08-21 [codex] While creating a work record, knowledge.propose accepted a topic parameter in its schema but validation rejected topic for planning kinds; omit topic for work records.  `@openarc.papercut.while-creating-a-work-record-knowledge-propose/1`
- 2026-08-21 [codex] While constructing a small batch benchmark, `batch-jxl` silently reported “Encoded 0 image(s)” for a directory containing symlinked supported RAW files. `find_images` neither follows nor reports skipped symlinks, which makes test/real input discovery misleading.  `@openarc.papercut.while-constructing-a-small-batch-benchmark/1`
- 2026-08-21 [codex] While checking JPXL dependency features, cargo tree rejected the profile-independent --release flag; rerun cargo tree without a profile flag.  `@openarc.papercut.while-checking-jpxl-dependency-features-cargo/1`
- 2026-08-21 [codex] The required `cargo test --release --workspace` gate cannot start because vendored `arcmax` declares five bin targets whose source files are absent (`compression-bench`, `dispack-file`, `profile-all`, `profile-ppmd-h`, `raw_analyze`). Targeted OpenArc/codecs release tests are the usable fallback.  `@openarc.papercut.the-required-cargo-test-release-workspace-gate/1`
- 2026-08-21 [codex] cargo fmt --all -- --check is already red across the uncommitted JPEG XL migration, including large unrelated files; avoid bulk formatting and verify touched-file formatting selectively.  `@openarc.papercut.cargo-fmt-all-check-is-already-red-across-the/1`
- 2026-08-21 [codex] `cargo fmt --all -- --check` and `git diff --check` cannot isolate this scheduler change: the in-progress JPEG XL migration already contains many unformatted files, and `src/orchestrator.rs` has CRLF lines that Git reports wholesale as trailing whitespace. Focused compile/tests are needed until that migration is normalized.  `@openarc.papercut.cargo-fmt-all-check-and-git-diff-check-cannot/1`
- 2026-08-21 [codex] A multi-file apply_patch for the JPXL preset surface was rejected atomically because a wrapped module-doc line did not match; split cross-file patches or use exact current line wrapping.  `@openarc.papercut.a-multi-file-apply-patch-for-the-jpxl-preset/1`
- 2026-08-21 [codex] A focused Rust unit-test invocation with a bare name plus --exact compiled but ran zero tests because the harness name included its module prefix; use a substring filter or the fully qualified name.  `@openarc.papercut.a-focused-rust-unit-test-invocation-with-a-bare/1`
- 2026-08-21 [codex] A 15-input `batch-jxl` stress run over paired ARW/JPG files reported 15 encodes but left only 8 outputs because both extensions map to the same `.jxl` stem. The standalone batch command should reject/disambiguate collisions or apply the archive pipeline's paired-JPEG policy.  `@openarc.papercut.a-15-input-batch-jxl-stress-run-over-paired-arw/1`
